answer.rationale: Deploy the already-confirmed in-product activation messaging broadly: it improved activation, week-one engagement, and 30-day retention, supporting durable account value without discounting. Do not respond with broad promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: the recovered price-sensitive SMB experiment lifted signup and near-term qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, making it inconsistent with the sustainable long-term qualified-revenue objective. Monitor price-sensitive SMB churn and escalation volume closely because activation messaging may not fully offset a competitor’s deeper price cut.
